context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment tracking feature is fully working. Status dropdown in Actions column of payment schedule table triggers API call to /api/payments/item/{customer_id}/{item_id} which returns updated total_received, balance_amount, payment_received_percentage, payment_pending_percentage. Frontend uses these values to update customer state immediately. Payment Summary section displays Total Value, Total Received, Balance Pending, and Progress indicator showing X of Y installments paid.
